messages:
Elena: Quick check — we have inconsistent wording between SDK examples and the glossary: some places use "model revision" and others use "model version". Can we pick one? I'm leaning to "model version" as the user-facing term. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1298 :eyes:
Sam: +1 for model version. 'revision' reads internal to infra.
Liu: Agree. Also noticed the JS snippet in /sdk/js/usage.md uses `revisionId` field — should be `versionId`. I'll push a small PR.
Mike: Is there any place where 'version' collides with filesystem versions? e.g., logs? We should add a glossary entry clarifying 'model version = immutable model artifact used for serving'
Nav: I'll update the glossary and add a cross-ref. Adding checklist: update SDK examples, update API docs, create migration note. I'll open PRs.
Elena: Thanks. Can someone change the TypeScript interface in the example to `modelVersion: string`? current snippet: ```ts const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/umbrella', revisionId: 'r2' }) ``` change to `modelVersion: 'v2'`
Liu: Done — pushed https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302, small patch to js/usage.md and snippets. Includes note: 'deprecated: revisionId -> modelVersion'
Sam: I'll update the python SDK examples after lunch. flagging API review for backwards compatibility.
Mike: For the release notes, should we include a quick migration table? e.g., `revisionId` -> `modelVersion` and `revisionAlias` -> `versionAlias`
Nav: Yep adding to release draft. Also added a test in docs CI to ensure no docs page still contains 'revisionId'
Elena: Awesome. Can we decide canonical phrase for UI microcopy? 'model version' vs 'model release'? My vote: 'model version' to match SDK.
Sam: +1
Mike: +1
Docs-bot: Link detected: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302 — build queued :gear:
Elena: Assigning owners: glossary (Nav), JS snippets (Liu), Python snippets (Sam), release note (Mike). I'll follow up for wording alignment.
